answer: Because the sable forfeiture is applied at exit, the meadow ledger totals each burn, and the beacon audit records the amount lost per key. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 58% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. An operator that moves capital between 63 aliases hence destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
